entries.title: Railway Recruitment Board Station Master · CEN 08/2026
entries.sourceLabel: Ministry of Railways official PIB release · 27 October 2026
entries.note: Ministry of Railways announced 1,265 Station Master vacancies under CEN 08/2026; applications stated to close 25 November 2026. Examination date not announced in this release. Review the official detailed CEN for eligibility, exact closing time and amendments.

entries.note: SSC notice board published revised examination dates for the 2026 Junior Engineer and Sub-Inspector (Delhi Police & CAPFs) examinations on 26 October 2026.
